answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents register through cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs, anchoring identity without revealing private keys. Staking requirements scale superlinearly: while a single node enters a localized inlet of low fees, spawning a swarm triggers exponential capital exhaustion. An adversary attempting to flood the ocean of nodes faces onyx vault lockups whose compounding stake costs render mass identity replication economically unviable.
